title: deckflow-core provider pin matrix
description: providers.json — the exact provider versions this core release was tested against. Changing any pin is a core release.

module.description: python providers only: the importable module, invoked as `python -m <module>` with PYTHONPATH pointing at the --target directory.

compatible.description: Whitespace-separated range terms, e.g. '>=0.3.2 <0.4.0'. An ambient install outside this range is ignored in favour of the managed copy.

registry.description: npm providers only: the intended public registry for THIS package. Pinned as the scope registry; the default registry always stays on npmjs so transitive dependencies keep resolving and a user .npmrc cannot hijack the pin.

fallback_registry.description: npm providers only: tried when the primary registry fails. Lets the matrix name the intended public registry before the package is published there; once it is, the fallback simply stops being reached.

index_url.description: python providers only: the intended public index.

source.description: python providers only: fallback origin (e.g. a git ref) tried when the index install fails. Its ref must name the pinned version. Dropped when a --provider-spec overrides the version.

public.description: False while the package is reachable only with organisation credentials. Such a provider emits PROVIDER_NOT_PUBLICLY_PUBLISHED, because an integrator outside the organisation cannot acquire it.

provides.description: Runtimes this provider brings with it, e.g. chromium-runtime. Core never bundles a browser of its own.
